title: Future Tech
completion_message: ¡Fascinante! Hablas de la tecnología del futuro como un visionario de Silicon Valley. Sabes diferenciar entre una simple tendencia y una verdadera disrupción.

parts.visual:
El vocabulario de la innovación radical y el futuro. 

1. Bleeding-edge (Tecnología de punta / Experimental): 
- Más nuevo que 'cutting-edge'. Tan nuevo que tiene alto riesgo de fallar (te hace 'sangrar'). 
Ej: They invest heavily in BLEEDING-EDGE artificial intelligence. 

2. Obsolescence (Obsolescencia): 
- El proceso de volverse obsoleto o inútil. 
Ej: Planned OBSOLESCENCE is a strategy to force people to buy new phones. 

3. Disruptor (Disruptor): 
- Una empresa o tecnología que cambia completamente las reglas de una industria. 
Ej: Uber was a massive DISRUPTOR in the taxi industry.
parts.audio: Welcome to Innovation and Future Tech. Number 1: Bleeding-edge. This means technology that is so new and experimental that it has a high risk of unreliability. It is newer than 'cutting-edge'. For example: They invest heavily in BLEEDING-EDGE artificial intelligence. Number 2: Obsolescence. The process of becoming obsolete or no longer used. For example: Planned OBSOLESCENCE is a strategy to force people to buy new phones. Number 3: Disruptor. A company or technology that radically changes how an industry operates, usually by making the old way obsolete. For example: Uber was a massive DISRUPTOR in the taxi industry.

parts.visual:
4. Singularity (La Singularidad): 
- El punto hipotético futuro donde la Inteligencia Artificial superará a la humana. 
Ej: Experts debate when the technological SINGULARITY will happen. 

5. Autonomous (Autónomo): 
- Que opera de forma independiente sin control humano. 
Ej: The streets will soon be filled with AUTONOMOUS vehicles. 

6. Scalability (Escalabilidad): 
- La capacidad de un sistema para crecer y manejar más demanda sin colapsar. 
Ej: Cloud computing provides infinite SCALABILITY for startups. 

7. State-of-the-art (Lo más avanzado): 
- La mejor tecnología disponible actualmente. 
Ej: The laboratory is equipped with STATE-OF-THE-ART machinery.
parts.audio: Number 4: Singularity. The hypothetical future point in time when artificial intelligence will surpass human intelligence and radically change civilization. For example: Experts debate when the technological SINGULARITY will happen. Number 5: Autonomous. Operating independently without human control. For example: The streets will soon be filled with AUTONOMOUS vehicles. Number 6: Scalability. The capacity of a system to be changed in size or scale to meet new demands. For example: Cloud computing provides infinite SCALABILITY for startups. Finally, Number 7: State-of-the-art. The most recent and highest level of development in a device or field. For example: The laboratory is equipped with STATE-OF-THE-ART machinery.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige el término tecnológico y de innovación correcto.

questions.question: This software is so new that it still crashes sometimes. It is ____-edge technology.
questions.explanation: Bleeding-edge = tecnología tan nueva que aún es inestable (más que cutting-edge).

questions.question: Many believe that companies use planned ____ to make phones slow down after two years, forcing you to buy a new one.
Netflix was a major ____ in the entertainment industry, destroying the traditional video rental business.
questions.explanation: Disruptor = empresa o tecnología que altera completamente una industria.

questions.question: The technological ____ is the hypothetical point when AI becomes smarter than humans and uncontrollable.
Tesla is investing billions in developing fully ____ vehicles that can drive themselves with zero human input.
questions.explanation: Autonomous = autónomo (que toma sus propias decisiones, no solo automático).

questions.question: The app works fine for 100 users, but if a million people download it, the servers will crash. We have a problem with ____.
This hospital uses ____-of-the-art robotic surgery equipment. (Lo más avanzado/vanguardia).
questions.explanation: State-of-the-art = el estado del arte, lo más moderno disponible.

questions.question: Using biological data like fingerprints or iris scans to unlock devices is called ____ security.
A decentralized, secure digital ledger used to record cryptocurrency transactions is the ____.
When a physical machine or tool is replaced by software or a digital version, it is called ____. (Digitalización/Desmaterialización).
questions.explanation: Dematerialization (o digitization) = desmaterialización (ej. la cámara física ahora es software en el móvil).

questions.question: An early, testable model of a new product built to test a concept or process is a ____.
To use a computer system to imitate a real-world process or situation for testing or training is to run a ____.
When computing power and data storage are delivered over the internet on-demand, it is called ____ computing.
questions.explanation: Cloud computing = computación en la nube.

questions.question: The science of making extremely small devices and materials at the atomic or molecular scale is ____.
A sudden, dramatic, and important discovery or technological advancement is a ____.
To secretly enter someone else's computer system or network without permission is to ____ it.
The network of physical objects (fridges, cars, lights) that are embedded with sensors and connected to the internet is the IoT, or the Internet of ____.
questions.explanation: Internet of Things (IoT) = el Internet de las Cosas.

questions.question: A type of machine learning where artificial neural networks learn from massive amounts of unstructured data is ____ learning.
Superimposing computer-generated images on top of the user's view of the real world is AR, or ____ Reality.
When a system or AI can improve itself over time without human programming, it is ____-improving.
questions.explanation: Self-improving = que se mejora a sí mismo.

questions.question: ____-edge. (Tecnología muy nueva y experimental con B)
Planned ____. (Obsolescencia programada con O)
A massive ____. (Disruptor en la industria con D)
The technological ____. (La Singularidad de la IA con S)
____ vehicles. (Vehículos autónomos con A)
We need infinite ____. (Escalabilidad con S)
____-of-the-art. (De vanguardia/lo mejor con S)
____ Reality. (Realidad Aumentada con A)
Internet of ____. (Internet de las cosas con T)
A major ____. (Avance científico rompedor con B)
